name: Scarlet Raven Tavern
summary: The Scarlet Raven Tavern is the social center and primary inn of Darkshire, offering hearthside shelter in the gloom of Duskwood. Presided over by Tavernkeep Smitts, it serves as a gathering spot for beleaguered locals, passing adventurers, and terrified travelers trying to escape the horrors lurking beyond the town's perimeter.

sections.title: A Dim Refuge
sections.body: Standing near the heart of Darkshire, the Scarlet Raven Tavern keeps its hearth ablaze while eternal dusk chokes the surrounding forest. Years ago, it was a bustling stop where Marshal Haggard and the Stormwind Guard would share pints after patrols. Today, business has withered alongside the town's security. Tavernkeep Smitts tends bar for a somber, anxious clientele huddled against the cold and fear. Even so, the tavern remains an indispensable crossroads for rumors, serving as the starting point for travelers seeking answers to the dark phenomena consuming the region.

sections.title: Secrets and Stolen Pints
sections.body: Beyond serving as a shelter, the tavern holds pieces of several unfolding mysteries. The reclusive wanderer Jitters rented a room here for days, frantically scribbling in his journal by night before fleeing town ahead of the terrifying Dark Riders. Decades-old town gossip and preserved guest records kept beneath its roof also link back to long-forgotten figures like Stalvan Mistmantle, making Smitts' taproom the first place inquisitive investigators search when tracing the histories of Duskwood's restless dead.

faq.q: Who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts owns and operates the tavern. He handles lodging, sells local fare, and laments the creeping corruption that has driven away customers and plunged Darkshire into gloom.

faq.q: Why is the tavern's atmosphere so gloomy?
faq.answer: The curse hanging over Duskwood has choked the trade routes and terrified the locals. With undead, feral worgen, and shadowy riders prowling the woods outside, the patron crowd consists of terrified townsfolk and desperate mercenaries rather than carefree travelers.

faq.q: Did Jitters stay at the Scarlet Raven?
faq.answer: Yes. Jitters took a room at the inn for several nights, drinking and frantically writing his journal. He fled in terror into the forest when the sinister Dark Riders arrived searching for him.

faq.q: What connection does this tavern have to the Legend of Stalvan?
faq.answer: Old patrons and past town records preserved in and around the tavern hold clues regarding Stalvan Mistmantle, who once frequented the settlement before falling into tragedy and infamy.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers traversing the southern border, the Scarlet Raven provides one of the few safe hearths and rest stops between Elwynn Forest and Deadwind Pass.
The inn's menu features regional delicacies like Dusky Crab Cakes, a local staple that desperate wanderers like Jitters crave even while hiding in the graveyard.
